author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Star Trek model miniatures make a great showing at this year's Wonderfest modelmaking convention, and we chat with two amazing builders who've brought their own takes on Star Trek's beautiful shuttlecraft. From a spacious Runabout as seen in Deep Space Nine to the sleek Type 9 shuttle from Voyager, we admire the details built into these models and the storytelling laid out in their dioramas. 

Find these kits at Cozmic Scale Models: https://www.cozmicscalemodels.com/
More of Lou's builds at: https://www.youtube.com/@aztekdummy
More of Oggie's builds at: https://www.youtube.com/c/InterstellarModeler
Watch more videos from WonderFest here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJtitKU0CAeisqS5CxeSZ5MRXtlTULAqo
Learn more about WonderFest at https://www.wonderfest.com/

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
